seo.meta_title: Lazy Dog Happy Hour: Times, Late Night and Menu Prices
seo.meta_description: Lazy Dog happy hour runs 3 to 6 p.m. weekdays, with a late-night happy hour Sunday to Thursday. Eats and drinks start at $3. Times and menu examples.

question: When Is Lazy Dog Happy Hour?
quick_answer: At most Lazy Dog restaurants, happy hour runs Monday through Friday from 3 to 6 p.m., with a late-night happy hour Sunday through Thursday from 9 p.m. to close (often midnight). Select eats and drinks start at $3, including small plates like Chef's Chips and House Bread, plus discounted margaritas, draft beers and sangria pitchers. Times and prices vary by location, so check your local Lazy Dog page.
key_facts: Mon-Fri, 3 to 6 p.m. at most locations
Late night: Sun-Thu, 9 p.m. to close
Margaritas, draft beer, wine and sangria pitchers
Times and prices vary by location

body.heading: Happy hour times
body.text: Most Lazy Dog locations run happy hour from 3 to 6 p.m., Monday through Friday. Many also have a late-night happy hour from 9 p.m. until close, Sunday through Thursday. For example, the Orange, California, location lists weekday happy hour from 3 to 6 p.m. and late night from 9 p.m. to midnight. Lazy Dog says hours and selections vary by location, so check your local restaurant's page before you go.

body.heading: Happy hour food
body.text: Lazy Dog says its happy hour eats start at just $3. Recent menus have included Chef's Chips and House Bread for $3 each, Roasted Red Pepper Hummus for $3, Tikka Masala Meatballs for $6 and a Hot Honey Feta Dip for $7. Longtime favorites like Buffalo Chicken Nuggets, Brussels sprouts, crispy deviled eggs and sweet potato tots also show up. Many seasonal small plates are added to the happy hour and late-night menus too.

body.heading: Happy hour drinks
body.text: Drink specials include margaritas, draft beers, well drinks, wine and sangria pitchers. Lazy Dog often puts its seasonal margaritas on happy hour, such as a Hibiscus Margarita for $7 instead of about $13, and some margaritas come as shareable pitchers. House drafts and domestic beers are discounted at many locations.

body.heading: Tips for Lazy Dog happy hour
body.text: At many locations happy hour pricing is for the bar and lounge area, so ask where it applies. Weekday afternoons between 3 and 6 p.m. tend to be less crowded than late night. If you bring your dog, many Lazy Dog patios are dog-friendly and even offer a small dog menu.

body.heading: Regular menu prices
body.text: Outside happy hour, Lazy Dog's regular menu runs higher, with entrees like the Campfire Pot Roast around $24 and burgers around $15. For full prices, see our Lazy Dog menu page.

faqs.q: What time is Lazy Dog happy hour?
faqs.a: Usually Monday to Friday, 3 to 6 p.m., plus late night Sunday to Thursday from 9 p.m. to close. Times vary by location.

faqs.q: Does Lazy Dog have late-night happy hour?
faqs.a: Yes. Most locations run late-night happy hour Sunday through Thursday from 9 p.m. to close.

faqs.q: How much is happy hour at Lazy Dog?
faqs.a: Select eats and drinks start at $3, with many small plates $3 to $7 and margaritas around $7.

faqs.q: Is Lazy Dog happy hour on weekends?
faqs.a: The regular happy hour is weekdays. Late-night happy hour includes Sunday at many locations.
